Measured value plausible for selected relay at recorded ambient temperature
Measured current at representative 12-14.5V supply recorded and within PMU O11 capability
A21 contact open and Two-Step request OFF
A21 pulled to approved ground only through NO contact and Two-Step request ON
No operating/fault state applies +12V to FT550 A21
Removal of O11 command opens A21 request circuit
Relay removal leaves A21 open and Two-Step OFF
Kill/master removal promptly removes Two-Step request
Selected relay uses intended resistor suppression; no unapproved parallel diode fitted
Measured release delay documented and accepted for launch transition
Contact resistance stable and appropriate for low-current ground request

Relay NO to FT550 A21 uses 0.35mm2 circuit 2STEP-REQ
Relay common terminates only to approved ground architecture
Relay cannot vibrate loose from socket/holder during manual retention test
Relay holder located away from direct turbo/exhaust heat and protected from spray
At least 100 bench operations without sticking/intermittency
